overview: The Community Development Board approved a site plan review for an addition to Eaton Hall at Tufts University and continued a hearing regarding an H Mart supermarket proposal at Townline Plaza. Staff also briefed the board on pending zoning amendments and upcoming summer agenda items.

items.title: Tufts University Eaton Hall Addition
items.summary: Approved a site plan review under the Dover Amendment for a two-story, 3,595-square-foot infill addition and interior alterations to Eaton Hall at Tufts University.

items.title: 285-295 Middlesex Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: Continued to June 21 the site plan review for converting a former fitness center into an H Mart supermarket at Townline Plaza, requesting further details on pedestrian safety, traffic circulation, and departmental conditions.

items.title: Proposed Zoning Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Staff briefed the board on several administrative corrections and a City Council proposal to require special permits for automobile-related uses, which will return for formal public hearings.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Staff Updates
items.summary: Approved the April 26 meeting minutes and reviewed upcoming hearings, board term expirations, and new planning department hires.
